title: Formal unit and AC course view
details: The Course arch now opens the formal qualification structure using official units and assessment criteria
Each unit shows its official title and AC coverage progress
Opening a unit shows every official AC and its full wording
Yellow remains Evia evidence, purple remains recognised prior learning, and blue remains Milos assessor observation
The simpler learner activity view remains available through Evia
summary: Evia v240 changes the Course arch to the formal qualification view: official units, official ACs and existing evidence-status colours.
changes: Preserved evidence, RPL and Milos status colours
